gloss: art of conversation; speaking skill; eloquence

definitions.gloss: art of conversation; speaking skill; eloquence; gift of gab
definitions.explanation: The skill or technique of engaging people through speech, encompassing storytelling, persuasion, and the ability to hold an audience's attention in conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{話術|わじゅつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|た}けている→長ける：14540_takeru⟧。
examples.english: He is skilled in the art of conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{巧|たく}み→巧み：07153_takumi⟧な{話術|わじゅつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{聴衆|ちょうしゅう}→聴衆：13907_choushuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}きつけた。
examples.english: He captivated the audience with skillful speaking.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{話術|わじゅつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧で、⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{解|と}けて→打ち解ける：07894_uchitokeru⟧しまう。
examples.english: That salesperson is so good at conversation that they can quickly break the ice with anyone.

notes:
Refers to the technique or skill of engaging people through speech — not just public speaking but the broader ability to hold and direct conversation effectively. Combines {話|わ} (talk, story) and ⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧ (technique, art).

USAGE:
- Covers a range of speaking abilities: storytelling, persuasion, entertainment, negotiation
- Often used to praise someone who can hold an audience's attention or smoothly navigate conversations
- Can also refer to the traditional Japanese art of ⟦{話芸|わげい}→話芸：25992_wagei⟧ (spoken performance arts like rakugo)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {話術|わじゅつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|た}ける→長ける：14540_takeru⟧: to be skilled in conversation
- {話術|わじゅつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧: good at speaking
- ⟦{巧|たく}み→巧み：07153_takumi⟧な{話術|わじゅつ}: skillful eloquence
- {話術|わじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: to polish one's speaking skills

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{弁舌|べんぜつ}→弁舌：27671_benzetsu⟧: eloquence, oratory — more formal, focuses on persuasive speaking
- ⟦{話芸|わげい}→話芸：25992_wagei⟧: spoken performance art — specifically traditional Japanese storytelling arts
- トーク{力|りょく}: talking ability — the loanword-based casual equivalent
- ⟦{雄弁|ゆうべん}→雄弁：14579_yuuben⟧: eloquence — more about powerful, persuasive rhetoric
